title: Fake It to Break It! Manga Changes Artists
content: Kotoko announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on September 1 Megumi Dorokawa ( Share House Nile ) will take over as the artist from Yone for the Fake It to Break It! I Faked Amnesia to Break off My Engagement and Now He’s All Lovey-Dovey?!
author: ANN

title: Tamer: Trash-Tier to Top-Tier Manga Ends
content: Overlap 's Comic Gardo platform published the final part of the last chapter of NiwaRhythm 's manga adaptation of Tamaki Yoshigae 's Tamer: Trash-Tier to Top-Tier ( Ore no Zense no Chishiki de Teihenshoku Tamer ga Jōkyūshoku ni Natte Shimaisō na Ken ) web novel for premium users on August 13.

title: 'Kimi wa Yotsuba no Clover' Gets Anime Adaptation
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account of author Koushi announced on Tuesday that the Kimi wa Yotsuba no Clover ( You Are a Four Leaf Clover ) manga is receiving an anime adaptation, revealing an announcement visual (pictured). Koushi began serializing the romantic thriller manga in Shounen Champion in July 2024.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Studio KAI Produces Hololive TV Anime 'Odeholo'
content: Production company Kadokawa and entertainment company Cover Corporation announced on Monday that VTuber agency Hololive is producing a television anime titled Odeholo , revealing an announcement visual (pictured above) and announcement promo.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Major Shonen Jump Creator Confirms Their Series Wasn’t Cancelled With New Update on Ending
content: One major Shonen Jump creator has broken their silence following their series coming to an end after two years, and revealed that their series wasn’t cancelled as fans might have thought considering how quickly it seemed to wrap up.
